setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern through the test MIDI device: trigs on steps 1 to 4 (the channel range) with notes C3, D3, E3 and F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. Tempo is the default 90 BPM, Rate is /1 (sixteenth-note steps, one sixth of a second each) and the sequencer is stopped. The norns shows channel 1's Device screen and every Mosaic option is at its default. Lock random to pent. and Lock merged to pent. are both On, and no trig params are assigned yet.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Lock random to pent. and turn E3 left to Off. The row shows Off. Random note offsets will now land on any degree of the seven-note scale.
steps.title: Turn Lock random to pent. Off

steps.caption: Select Lock merged to pent. and turn E3 left to Off. The row shows Off. That option only affects notes made by merge modes, so it has no effect on this lesson's random notes; the recording turns it Off here and you can leave it On.
steps.title: Turn Lock merged to pent. Off (not needed here)

steps.caption: Close the menu. On Channel tasks > Trig params assign Random Note to the first slot. The slot list shows Random Note; its value is still 0, so the pattern is unchanged.
steps.title: Assign Random Note

steps.caption: Assign Twos Random Note to the second slot in the same way. It stays at 0, so it adds nothing to this lesson; only Random Note is used.
steps.title: Assign Twos Random Note

steps.caption: Press Play (1,8) with Random Note at 0: the pattern repeats C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) with no random offsets. Stop playback.
steps.title: Hear the plain pattern

steps.caption: Raise Random Note to 4 in single steps: turn E3 right once, press Play (1,8) and Stop, and repeat until it reads 4. Random Note 4 offsets each note by -2, -1, 0, +1 or +2 scale degrees chosen at random, and with Lock random to pent. Off the results use all seven degrees of C major. The recorded final run begins 57, 64, 67, 62, 64, 59, 65, 65. F (65) and B (59) are in C major but outside C D E G A, so hearing them shows the lock is off. Random notes change on every run: play several loops and expect F and B to turn up now and then.
steps.title: Hear random notes on all seven degrees

title: Lock random notes to pentatonic: Off
